name: Reading Room
objectiveText: Bring the wrapped reading material to the Stormwind library. Wrapped Reading Material (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body:
This new Forever quest can be picked up at [b]The Park[/b] at level 13.

Run to the Stormwind Library, turn it in, pick the next part and then look around the bookshelves for the [b]4[/b] books and run back to [npc=268568] to turn it in.

The 4 book locations for the follow-up are as follows:
[ul][li][item=277196]: [b]scroll[/b] under first row of bookshelves on side of entrance[/li]
[li][item=277194]: [b]green book[/b] on same row of bookshelves from side of entrance[/li]
[li][item=277195]: [b]red book[/b] on second row of bookshelves on same side[/li]
[li][item=277197]: [b]black book[/b] on table north corner[/li][/ul]

[b]1680[/b] total XP from this one, and a little drink to top it off!
replies: In Stormwind Keep where it's always been.
